alerts.title: Overdue TDF renal monitoring
alerts.message: Guidelines require serum creatinine and eGFR every 12 months for experienced patients on TDF. The patient's most recent creatinine was 478 days before this visit, exceeding the annual monitoring interval. No renal monitoring was ordered in today's plan. TDF can cause renal toxicity, making regular surveillance essential. The latest creatinine of 88 umol/L appears normal, but no recent trend can be assessed given the 15-month gap.

evidence.recommended_action: Order serum creatinine and eGFR at this visit and ensure annual renal monitoring is scheduled for TDF-based ART.

alerts.title: Low-level viremia on DTG regimen
alerts.message: Guidelines emphasize active monitoring for low-level viremia in patients on DTG-based regimens to preserve DTG durability. Viral load of 40 copies/mL is below the suppression cutoff of 200 copies/mL for plasma samples, confirming virologic suppression. However, detectable low-level viremia warrants enhanced adherence support and close follow-up to prevent progression to treatment failure. No repeat viral load was ordered in today's plan.

evidence.recommended_action: Provide adherence counseling and schedule a follow-up viral load per guideline monitoring frequency to ensure sustained suppression.
